# Files that CI builds or runs but that do not change the shipped binaries:
# a change to them is tested, and a push to main that only touches these
# and the files of no-ci.txt is tested but not released.
# One bash `case` glob per line, matched against the path from the repo
# root (`*` also matches `/`). Lines starting with # and blank lines are
# ignored.
#
# Note: src/data/** is embedded in the binary, so it is not listed here.

# test drivers and tools, built by `zig build` and run in CI
tests/*
tools/*
# the conda-forge recipe, built by the conda package jobs
packaging/*
# line endings at checkout, which the tests can see
.gitattributes
# CI's workflows, lists and scripts, and the release notes' sections. A
# change to how ci.yml builds the binaries (optimize mode, minimum macOS)
# is released with the next change to the binaries themselves.
.github/*
